decisions.reason: The black-finish range was publicly launched as part of the firm's black bathroom concept and was upgraded to its own page in 2024, signalling growing visible commitment, and it extends existing lines at little extra cost, so dropping it would contradict the announced design direction.

The CeraFrame Liquid channel for seamless bathrooms has kept its own page since its publicised 2023 launch and fits the announced barrier-free, modern-bathroom strategy, so management would keep it rather than admit the launch was a mistake.

The pump-drain shower channel is only one year old and has its own page, so weak early results can still be blamed on a market ramp-up, and its development effort, built on the earlier pump-assisted line, gives management reason to persist even though Product C disappeared.
